subject: pe
title: Health & Nutrition: Eatwell Guide
welcome_lead: The UK Eatwell Guide shows what a balanced plate looks like.
meta_desc: KS3 PE: Eatwell Guide, portion sizes, sugar limits.
final_note: Plate building is a skill — once you learn it, it sticks.

concepts.def: How much of a food you eat.

walkthroughs.body_html: About a third fruit and veg, a third starchy carbs, then dairy, protein and small amounts of oil. Limit sugar and salt.
Aim for at least five portions of fruit and veg daily. Each portion is about a handful.
Too much sugar rots teeth and adds calories. Too much salt raises blood pressure. Check labels.
